UKR.note: USDA Oilseeds MY2024/25: Ukraine is the world's #1 sunflower-oil producer (~5.8 Mt) and exporter (~5.2 Mt). Drought cut the 2024 sunseed crop, trimming exports but still ~45% of world sunflower-oil trade.

RUS.note: USDA Oilseeds MY2024/25: Russia overtook Ukraine as the largest sunflower-oil producer (~7 Mt) on a record 2024 crush; sunflower-oil exports ~5 Mt-plus. Top supplier to India, Turkey, China, Egypt. Also exports rapeseed oil.

ARG.note: USDA Oilseeds MY2024/25: Argentina is the #3 sunflower-oil exporter (~1.2 Mt), the main non-Black-Sea origin.

CAN.note: USDA Oilseeds MY2024/25: Canada is the dominant canola-oil (rapeseed, HS 1514) exporter (~3.5 Mt). The USA alone imported 3,388 kt of Canadian canola oil in 2024 (WITS, ~98% of US rapeseed-oil imports).

IND.note: WITS/UN Comtrade 2024: India imported 3,740 kt of sunflower oil (HS 1512) — world's #1 sunflower-oil importer — from Russia 2,025 + Ukraine 1,175 + Argentina 375 kt, plus ~7 kt rapeseed oil. Combined ~3,748 kt.

CHN.note: WITS/UN Comtrade 2024: China imported 1,090 kt sunflower oil (HS 1512: Russia 703 + Ukraine 246 + Kazakhstan 115) and 1,881 kt rapeseed oil (HS 1514: Russia 1,094 + UAE 323 + Belarus 238 + Ukraine 141 + Kazakhstan 60) — combined ~2,971 kt.

EU.note: WITS/UN Comtrade 2024: EU-27 imported 3,036 kt sunflower oil (HS 1512: Ukraine 2,859 + Serbia 74 + Moldova 47) and 391 kt rapeseed oil (HS 1514: Ukraine 197 + Belarus 98 + UAE 42) — combined ~3,427 kt. Ukraine supplies ~94% of EU sunflower-oil imports.

TUR.note: WITS/UN Comtrade 2024: Turkey imported 1,408 kt of sunflower oil (HS 1512) — Russia 797 + Ukraine 526 kt (~94%). A major Black-Sea refining/re-export hub.

EGY.note: WITS/UN Comtrade 2024: Egypt imported 720 kt of sunflower oil (HS 1512) — Russia 458 + Ukraine 195 kt (~91%). One of the largest MENA vegoil buyers.

USA.note: WITS/UN Comtrade 2024: USA imported 3,437 kt of rapeseed/canola oil (HS 1514) — Canada alone 3,388 kt (~98.6%), the single largest bilateral vegoil flow here, driven by renewable-diesel demand. Plus ~27 kt sunflower oil.

ZAF.note: WITS/UN Comtrade 2024: South Africa imported 187 kt of sunflower oil (HS 1512) — Bulgaria 112 + Argentina 25 + Romania 23 kt. Unusually EU/Balkan-sourced rather than Black-Sea direct.

IRQ.note: Iraq does not report to UN Comtrade for 2024. USDA/trade estimate: ~0.5 Mt sunflower-oil imports, mainly Russia, Ukraine, Turkey-refined product. Modeled, not importer-reported.

DZA.note: Algeria does not report timely Comtrade data for 2024. USDA/mirror estimate: ~0.6 Mt sunflower-oil imports (Argentina, Ukraine, Russia). Modeled, not importer-reported.

IRN.note: Iran reports little to UN Comtrade. USDA/trade estimate: ~1.0-1.2 Mt sunflower-oil imports, predominantly Russia and via UAE. Modeled, not importer-reported.

SAU.note: Saudi Arabia is a vegoil refiner/re-exporter; full HS 1512/1514 detail not in 2024 Comtrade. USDA/trade estimate: ~0.3 Mt sunflower+rapeseed-oil imports. Modeled.

JPN.note: Japan mainly imports rapeseed/canola SEED for domestic crush rather than finished oil; finished sunflower+rapeseed-oil imports (HS 1512/1514) are modest (~0.25 Mt). Modeled from USDA balances.

BLR.note: Belarus is a rapeseed-oil exporter and Russian-oil transit/re-export point. Mirror data (importer reports) 2024: China imported 238 kt and EU 98 kt of rapeseed oil (HS 1514) from Belarus.

ARE.note: UAE is a vegoil re-export hub for rapeseed oil sourced mainly from Canada/EU. Mirror data 2024: China imported 323 kt, EU 42 kt, USA 15 kt of rapeseed oil (HS 1514) recorded as UAE-origin. Flows are re-exports.

rankings.note: Exporter ranks (UKR/RUS sunflower oil, CAN canola oil, ARG sunflower oil) from USDA Oilseeds MY2024/25; ARE and BLR are re-export/transit shown on a gross-flow basis. Importer ranks are WITS/UN Comtrade 2024 gross imports across HS 1512+1514 combined, except IRN/IRQ/DZA which are USDA/trade estimates (non-reporters). Russia narrowly trails Ukraine in sunflower oil; the two are co-leaders.

companies.name: Kernel Holding
companies.metric: Revenue ~US$3.5bn (FY ended Jun-2024); ~8% of global sunflower-oil exports
companies.note: World's largest sunflower-oil producer/exporter; operates crush plants and Black-Sea export terminals despite the war.
companies.improve: Should disclose war-risk-adjusted export-terminal throughput and the share of crop sourced from occupied vs free territory.

companies.name: Bunge Global
companies.metric: Net sales ~US$53.1bn (FY2024); among the largest sunflower- and rapeseed-oil processors
companies.note: Global oilseed crusher with plants across Ukraine, the EU and the Americas; completed the Viterra acquisition in 2025.
companies.improve: Should break out sunflower vs rapeseed crush volumes by region to show Black-Sea exposure post-merger.

companies.name: Cargill
companies.metric: Revenue ~US$160bn (FY2024, private); major canola/rapeseed and sunflower oil processor
companies.note: Large North American canola-oil refining footprint serving food and renewable-diesel demand.
companies.improve: Privately held; should disclose canola-oil refining capacity and renewable-diesel feedstock share by origin.

companies.name: Archer-Daniels-Midland (ADM)
companies.note: Runs canola and sunflower crush/refining in North America and Europe; Ag Services & Oilseeds is its largest segment.
companies.improve: Should report oilseed crush split (canola vs sunflower vs soy) by region for trade-exposure transparency.

companies.name: Viterra
companies.metric: Leading Canadian canola-oil exporter; built a large new canola crush plant at Regina (Saskatchewan). Merged into Bunge in 2025.
companies.note: Major canola origination and crushing supplying the renewable-diesel market.
companies.improve: Post-Bunge-merger, should clarify combined Canadian canola-oil export capacity to avoid double-counting with Bunge.

companies.name: COFCO International
companies.metric: Group revenue >US$70bn (FY2024); major importer of rapeseed and sunflower oil into China
companies.note: State-linked trader; major Chinese vegoil importer and operator of domestic crush capacity.
companies.improve: Should disclose import volumes by origin given China's heavy reliance on Russian/Belarusian/UAE-routed rapeseed oil.

global.note: Global sunflower oil + rapeseed/canola oil combined, kt (USDA Oilseeds). Output rose through 2023/24 on record Black-Sea sunflower crops and rising Canadian/EU canola crush for renewable diesel; 2022 dipped on the Ukraine-war disruption. Trade (~19-20 Mt) is ~36% of output.
